title: Forest Honey | Aesthlos
description: Our collections come from Mountainous Ilia and the famous Forest of Foloi, as well as from the mountainous region of Evia, the towering Dirfi. Forests filled with oaks, chestnut trees, pines, firs, beeches, plane trees, mastic trees, ash trees, wild pear trees, heathers, spartium, walnut trees, wildflowers, peonies, primroses, fruit trees, and higher up, alpine junipers.
